title: Sleepy Animals for Kids! Who Rests the Most?
description:
Which animals rest the most? Pick your answer with Milo the bluebird, then find out: a koala sits or sleeps about 20 hours a day, a lion may rest up to 20 hours a day and is busiest at night, and a sleeping polar bear's heart slows down to about 8 to 10 beats a minute.
An interactive animal lesson for kids ages 2-6, with questions to answer, counting, actions to copy, quick checks and a quiz at the end.
facts: Koala: an adult spends about 19-20 hours/day sitting, sleeping; low energy lifestyle is necessary for an animal that specializes on such a low energy diet; most often described as nocturnal, with some activities during the day; nighttime tree for feeding often not the same tree used in day for resting; eucalyptus branches grow out at sharp angles, which helps koalas wedge themselves in (SDZWA Library fact sheet 'Koala', Behavior & Ecology, ielc.libguides.com/sdzg/factsheets/koala/behavior, read Nov 17 2026).

Lion: may rest up to 20-21 hours per day, on average; peak activity after 5 pm and before 8 am; hunt actively at night; active early and late in the day and at night to avoid the heat of the day; grooming and social licking strengthen the social bonds between pride members; groom and play around dawn and especially in the evening (SDZWA Library fact sheet 'Lion', Behavior & Ecology, ielc.libguides.com/sdzg/factsheets/lions/behavior, read Nov 17 2026).

Polar bear: sleeping heart rate can fall as low as 8-10 beats/minute; in summer and autumn, bears forced onto land dig sleeping pits and temporary dens (SDZWA Library fact sheet 'Polar Bear', Behavior & Ecology, ielc.libguides.com/sdzg/factsheets/polarbear/behavior, read Nov 17 2026).

segments.name: hello
lines: Hello, friends! I am Milo the bluebird.
Today we are learning about sleepy animals!
Who rests the most? Let's find out!
Three animal friends will show us. Count them with me. One, two, three!
Stretch and yawn. Let's go!

segments.name: koala

lines.t: Who sits and sleeps in a tree, for most of the day?
Is it the koala? Or is it the pig?

lines: It is the koala!
Here is the fun fact. A koala sits or sleeps for about twenty hours a day!
Twenty hours! That is almost the whole day. Shh.

lines.t: Why does a koala rest so much? Hmm.

lines: Its food is eucalyptus leaves, and they do not give it much energy. So it rests a lot!
Look at that sleepy koala.
close:koala
Eucalyptus branches grow out at sharp angles. A koala tucks itself in, nice and snug.
Snug and safe, high in the tree. Sweet dreams, little koala!
Koalas often do their eating at night.
It may eat in one tree at night, and rest in a different tree in the day!
Say it with me. A koala rests about twenty hours a day!
close:host
Can you hug a tree like a koala? Hold on tight, and close your eyes.
Now yawn a big, sleepy koala yawn. Yawn! Shh.

lines.t: Quick check! What does a koala do most of the day? Sleeping? Or running?

lines: Sleeping! Shh. Great job!

short.title: How Long Does a Koala Sleep? Koala Facts for Kids

segments.name: lion

lines.t: Which big cat may rest for up to twenty hours a day?
Is it the lion? Or is it the cow?

lines: It is the lion!
Here is the fun fact. A lion may rest for up to twenty hours a day!
Lying in the shade, taking a long, long nap. Yawn! Shh, let it sleep.

lines.t: When is a lion the busiest? Hmm.

lines: Early and late in the day, and at night! That way it stays out of the heat of the day.
Look at that big, sleepy lion.
close:lion
Lions do their hunting at night, when it is cooler.
In the early morning and in the evening, lions are busy and awake. Up and about!
Lion friends lick each other, to groom. Lick, lick!
Grooming helps the lions in a family stay close friends. So sweet! Lick, lick, lick!
Say it with me. A lion rests most of the day!
close:host
Can you stretch like a lion after a nap? Big stretch, and a big yawn!
Now lick your paw, like a lion grooming. Lick, lick! Nice and clean!

lines.t: Quick check! When is a lion busy? At night? Or at lunch time?

lines: At night! And early and late in the day. You remembered!

short.title: How Long Can a Lion Nap? Lion Facts for Kids

segments.name: polar_bear

lines.t: Whose heart beats very, very slowly when it sleeps?
Is it the polar bear? Or is it the pig?

lines: It is the polar bear!
Here is the fun fact. When a polar bear sleeps, its heart slows way down!
Put your hand on your heart. Can you feel it go thump, thump?

lines.t: How slow can a sleeping polar bear's heart go? Hmm.

lines: As slow as eight to ten beats in a whole minute! Thump. Thump. Thump.
Look at that big, white bear.
close:polar_bear
In summer and fall, some polar bears on land dig a sleeping pit.
Dig, dig, dig, then curl up inside. A cozy bed in the ground!
A polar bear sleeps, and its heart goes slow and steady.
Slow and steady, while it dreams. Shh! Sleep tight, polar bear.
Say it with me. A sleeping polar bear has a slow heart!
close:host
Can you dig a sleeping pit like a polar bear? Dig, dig, dig!
Now curl up, and breathe slow and steady. In, and out.

lines.t: Quick check! When a polar bear sleeps, does its heart go slower? Or faster?

lines: Slower! Thump. Thump. Super thinking!

short.title: How Slow Is a Sleeping Polar Bear's Heart?

segments.name: quiz
lines: Wow! We met three sleepy friends. Now it is quiz time!
Get ready. Think hard!
quiz: Who sits or sleeps about twenty hours a day, in a tree?
Who hunts at night and naps in the day?
Whose heart goes slow when it sleeps?

segments.name: goodbye
lines: You learned so many new things today.
Snug like a koala. Stretch like a lion. And slow and steady like a polar bear!
How do you like to rest?
Thank you for learning with me. Bye-bye, friends! See you next time!
